text: At its meeting on November 8, 2022, the Toronto Parking Authority – Audit and Risk Management Committee considered Item PR3.5 and made recommendation to the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority. Summary from the report (October 26, 2022) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority: The purpose of this report is to provide the Audit and Risk Management Committee of the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority and Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority with a status update to the May 10, 2022 Action Items.
The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority received the report (October 26, 2022) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority for information.
